# Veyvox 1.17.1

## Juno: neon sound effects

- Added the 16 supplied effects for cards, special plays, drawing, shuffling,
  JUNO announcements, reports, turn alerts, results and local controls.
- The existing **Effects** slider in Juno settings controls the entire pack,
  together with the global sound-effects volume. Changes apply live; zero volume
  or self/space deafen stops playing and pending effects.
- Confirmed game actions sound for people following the voice table. Selection,
  buttons, invalid actions and turn alerts are local; spectators do not hear a
  personal victory/defeat. Reloads, polling and reconnect do not replay history.
- Music and the original memory-card dubbing are unchanged. All effects use the
  existing output device/limiter and are never published to voice or microphone.

No game-rule, API, federation, scoring, database or preference migration is needed.
The original supplied Ogg files are preserved unchanged with recorded hashes;
duplicate editing/preview formats are not shipped. Desktop signing and platform
limitations remain those documented for 1.17.0.

## Português (Brasil)

O Juno agora usa os 16 efeitos sonoros neon nas jogadas, cartas especiais, compra,
anúncio de JUNO, denúncia, início de turno, resultado e controles locais.
O volume fica no controle **Efeitos sonoros** que já existe nas configurações do
jogo, respeitando também o volume global e o ensurdecimento. Música e dublagem da
carta de memória foram preservadas. As regras, pontuações e dados não mudam.
